subject: Create output store (src/storage/output-store.ts) + tests
description:
Create `src/storage/output-store.ts` with `OutputStore` class:
- constructor(baseDir, maxOutputs=24) — ensures directory exists
- `save(imageBuffer, metadata)` — writes PNG + JSON sidecar, purges old outputs, returns image path
- `getLatest()` — returns most recent RenderMetadata or null
- `listAll()` — returns all metadata sorted newest first
- `getMetaFilesSorted()` — private, reads dir, filters .json, sorts by mtime desc
- `loadMetadata(filePath)` — private, reads and parses JSON
- `purgeOldOutputs()` — private, removes oldest files beyond maxOutputs

Also create `src/storage/index.ts` with re-export.

Create `tests/storage/output-store.test.ts` with:
- save and retrieve metadata
- purge old outputs when exceeding max
- getLatest returns null on empty store
- listAll returns sorted results

Depends on: types.ts (Task #2)
